analyst_view.overall: Early view: with a month to go, Iberia 1999 (29th, one point) host Red Star (15th, four points) on matchday 5. Red Star's European games have been open (3-2, 2-2, 2-1), while Iberia have scored two in three. Aleksandar Katai, sent off against Inter Escaldes, should be back by then once he has served his ban at Gent. I found no domestic news for either side.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals. I lean a little higher: all three of Red Star's games have had at least three goals, and Iberia conceded two in Copenhagen. With Katai back, Red Star should be at their most dangerous.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners. I read nothing that moves this.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.7 cards. No referee is known this far out and nothing else points away from the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.0 shots, 15.8 for Red Star. That split fits the gap between the sides; I stay with it.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.9 shots on target. Red Star's scoring supports a decent count; I stay with the number until team news.
